title: Fossilize
summary: FOS'SILIZE, verb transitive To convert into a fossil; as, to fossilize bones or wood. FOS'SILIZE, verb intransitive To become or be changed into a fossil.

inlines.v: FOS'SILIZE, verb transitive To convert into a fossil; as, to fossilize bones or wood. FOS'SILIZE, verb intransitive To become or be changed into a fossil.
